title: SGLang PD disaggregation: latency, PD queues, KV transfer, EFA and joint-SLO goodput
description: SGLang prefill/decode disaggregation (and its aggregated baseline): engine latency histograms, replicas, SGLang's per-role PD queues, KV transfer latency/speed/volume and failures, EFA RDMA counters per node, GPU utilization, and the joint-SLO goodput of scored runs. Extends awsome-distributed-ai eks-managed-observability's sglang-pd.json (at 25d5723cb62ab1f83b0f4307c28c8f3496bfaa53). Needs the sglang, distai-pd-score and dcgm-gpu scrape jobs in examples/inference/_shared/dashboards/scrape-configs.yaml and the efa-exporter job from awsome-distributed-ai eks-managed-observability.

panels.title: TTFT p50/p90/p99 by role (decode, or aggregated)
panels.description: sglang:time_to_first_token_seconds, recorded on the engine that streams the answer: decode in disagg-pd, the aggregated engine in agg-baseline. Engine-side; the client-measured TTFT is score.py's.

panels.title: Inter-token latency p50/p90/p99 by role (decode, or aggregated)
panels.description: sglang:inter_token_latency_seconds, engine-side. An average-style histogram: the per-request longest gap the SLO uses is client-measured by score.py, not this panel.

panels.title: End-to-end request latency p50/p90/p99 by role (decode, or aggregated)
Prefill replicas
panels.description: Scrape targets that are up: count(up{job=sglang,component=prefill}==1).

panels.title: Decode replicas
panels.description: Scrape targets that are up: count(up{job=sglang,component=decode}==1).

panels.title: TTFT P90 (decode, or aggregated)
panels.description: KEDA trigger ttft_p90, threshold 0.7 s.

panels.title: Inter-token latency P90 (decode, or aggregated)
panels.description: KEDA trigger tpot_p90, threshold 0.015 s.

panels.title: Replicas over time
panels.description: Number of up SGLang targets per role.

panels.title: KV cache token usage
panels.description: sglang:token_usage, fraction of KV cache tokens in use.

panels.title: Prefill disaggregation queues
panels.description: Prefill-side PD queues: requests waiting for their bootstrap handshake with a decode engine, and requests whose KV is being sent.

panels.title: Decode disaggregation queues
panels.description: Decode-side PD queues: waiting for KV memory to be pre-allocated, waiting for the KV transfer, waiting to receive KV into host memory, and finished requests whose KV release is deferred.

panels.title: Failed KV transfers and bootstraps per second
panels.description: sglang:num_transfer_failed_reqs_total and sglang:num_bootstrap_failed_reqs_total. Must stay at zero in a valid run: the router does not retry (router.disableRetries), so each one is also a failed request in score.py.

panels.title: Waiting requests by role
panels.description: sglang:num_queue_reqs: requests in the scheduler's waiting queue, per role.

panels.title: KV transfer latency (prefill to decode)
panels.description: sglang:kv_transfer_latency_ms, reported by prefill engines (one sample per TP rank). Its buckets are fixed at 1..5000 ms (observability/metrics_collector.py), so every quantile saturates at 5000 ms for slower transfers: a flat line at 5000 means 'at least 5 s', not 5 s.

panels.title: KV transfer speed (average per TP rank)
panels.description: Mean of sglang:kv_transfer_speed_gb_s over the last minute.

panels.title: KV transfer volume (all TP ranks)
panels.description: rate(sglang:kv_transfer_total_mb_sum). Compare with the RDMA write throughput below.

panels.title: EFA TX per node
panels.description: Sum over all EFA devices on the node.

panels.title: RDMA write per node
panels.description: RDMA write bytes sent and received. With PD disaggregation, prefill nodes send and decode nodes receive.

panels.title: RDMA read per node
panels.description: RDMA read bytes and read responses. Zero when the KV transfer backend uses RDMA write only.

panels.title: EFA TX per device
panels.description: Shows how traffic spreads over the EFA devices of each node.

panels.title: EFA errors and drops (per second)
panels.description: All should stay at 0.

panels.title: SGLang pod placement
panels.description: Which node each prefill / decode pod runs on. Use it to read the per-node RDMA panels.

panels.title: Joint-SLO goodput per GPU, per scored run
panels.description: distai_pd_goodput_per_gpu pushed by examples/inference/_shared/scorer/to_prom.py: requests meeting the TTFT limit and the longest-gap limit jointly, per GPU-second, drain included. One step per scored run; the slo_* labels carry the limits it was scored against.

panels.title: Joint-SLO attainment share of planned requests, per scored run
panels.description: distai_pd_joint_attainment_share: jointly attaining requests divided by the planned request count (not by the requests that happened to complete).

panels.title: GPU utilization (DCGM, skeleton - no real run yet)
GPU utilization percent, per node, averaged across its GPUs (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL)
panels.description: avg by (kubernetes_node) of DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL from the dcgm-gpu scrape job (examples/inference/_shared/dashboards/scrape-configs.yaml) - one value per GPU on the node, averaged, not a node-level metric DCGM itself reports. Skeleton panel: no real run has fed this job yet, see this directory's own README.

panels.title: GPU memory used bytes, per node, summed across its GPUs (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED)
panels.description: sum by (kubernetes_node) of DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED (framebuffer/HBM used, MiB in DCGM's own unit, converted here) from the dcgm-gpu scrape job - summed across every GPU DCGM reports for that node, not a node-level metric DCGM itself reports. Skeleton panel: no real run has fed this job yet, see this directory's own README. Double-counts if both the standalone dcgm-exporter chart and the GPU Operator's own bundled copy run at once on the same node - do not run both.
